scenicChapters.title: Dawson City → Top of the World summit
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 132 km. 1376 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Top of the World Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: 62 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

top-of-the-world-highway-dawson-city-chi.story: 310 km from Dawson City to the finish, about 4 h 15 of riding. The stops in between: Top of the World summit and Poker Creek border. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It crosses from Canada into United States - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 34 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
